limitations: Shares are estimated from 9 fixed-timecode samples per legacy video, not true screen-time fractions (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §7). The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Scatter of split_share against robust_z, one point per analysed code.
title: Split-screen share vs performance
